description:
Beka ukuphepha komndeni wakho kuqala nge-Familo - indlela elula nephephile yokuhlala uxhumene.

I-Familo isiza amalungu omndeni ukuthi ahlale enolwazi futhi exhumanisa kalula usuku lonke. Ngemvume ecacile kanye nokucaca okugcwele, yenzelwe ukuthula kwengqondo - isiza imindeni ukuthi izizwe isondelene futhi isekelwa kakhulu, ngisho noma ihlukene.

I-Familo inikeza izici ezilandelayo:

- Buka indawo yangempela yamalungu omndeni agunyaziwe kumephu yomndeni eyimfihlo
- Thola isaziso uma amalungu omndeni efika noma ehamba nezindawo ezichazwe kusengaphambili (njengekhaya noma isikole)
- Sebenzisa inkinobho ye-SOS yokwabelana ngendawo ephuthumayo
- Xoxa ngasese nomndeni wakho ngaphakathi kohlelo lokusebenza - hlala uxhumekile noma nini
- Yazisa amalungu omndeni ukuthi ulungile ngokungena okusheshayo endaweni yakho yamanje
- Ukwabelana ngendawo kuhlale kuvunyelwe ukungena - ilungu ngalinye lomndeni lilawula ukubonakala kwalo
- Ilungu ngalinye lomndeni linquma ukuthi ubani ongabona indawo yalo

🔒 Isaziso sobumfihlo esibalulekile:

- I-Familo idinga imvume ecacile evela kubo bonke abasebenzisi ngaphambi kokwabelana ngendawo.
- Indawo yabelwana kuphela ngaphakathi kwendilinga yakho yomndeni eyimfihlo ngemuva kokunikezwa imvume.
- Ngaphandle kwale mvume, idatha yendawo ayibonakali.

Ukuqala nge-Familo GPS Locator:

- Landa bese usetha: Mane nje ufake uhlelo lokusebenza bese unikeza izimvume ezibalulekile, njengokufinyelela indawo, ukuze usebenze ngokugcwele.
- Yakha umbuthano wakho wangasese: Sungula noma ujoyine iqembu lomndeni elivikelekile. Ubulungu bukhethekile kulabo obamemayo futhi abavuma ngokusobala ukujoyina.
- Thumela izimemo: Mema kalula amalungu omndeni usebenzisa inombolo yabo yocingo, isixhumanisi esiyingqayizivele, noma ikhodi ye-QR.
- Imvume ibalulekile: Ukuze ukwabelana ngendawo kuqale, wonke amalungu omndeni amenyiwe kumele amukele isimemo ngokuzithandela futhi anikeze zonke izimvume ezidingekayo, kufaka phakathi izinsizakalo zendawo, kudivayisi yabo.
- Hlala unolwazi: Siqinisekisa ukuthi wonke amalungu omndeni athola izaziso ezicacile ezichaza injongo yohlelo lokusebenza, ukuthi ubani owammemile, nokuthi ulwazi lwendawo yawo luzosetshenziswa kanjani eqenjini.
- Ukulawula kwakho, njalo: I-Familo isebenza kuphela ngesivumelwano esisebenzayo selungu ngalinye lomndeni sokwabelana ngendawo yalo. Uma imvume igodliwe, ukwabelana ngendawo kwalelo lungu kuzohlala kungasebenzi.

I-Familo isebenza kuphela ngezimvume ezilandelayo ukuze inikeze ukusebenza okugcwele:

- Ukufinyelela indawo: ukwabelana ngesikhathi sangempela, i-geofencing, kanye nezaziso ze-SOS
- Izaziso: ukukwazisa mayelana nokungena noma izaziso zokuphepha
- Oxhumana nabo: ukumema amalungu omndeni athembekile
- Izithombe nekhamera: ukwenza amaphrofayili abe ngezifiso ngezithombe

I-Familo izibophezele ekuvikelekeni, ekubonakaleni, nasekusetshenzisweni okunesibopho.

Singathanda impendulo yakho! Yabelana ngemibono yakho nathi ku-support@familo.net

Imigomo Yokusebenzisa: https://terms.familo.net/en/Terms_and_Conditions_Familonet.pdf
Inqubomgomo Yobumfihlo: https://terms.familo.net/privacy
